allow: Bash(for file in FromImageLinkToNumbering.cs ManageEmojiAsImages.cs ManageLinkAsImages.cs ManageLinkAbsolutePath.cs)
Bash(for file in FromEmojiToTextGitHub.cs FromLinkToMarkdownGitHub.cs FromPlantumlToPngGitHub.cs)

Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
fix: prevent XML parsing crashes in GitHub Compatible Mode

Add compatibility mode awareness to command system to prevent XML parsing
errors when processing GitHub-flavored markdown HTML.

Changes:
- Extended ICommand interface with SupportedModes property
- Updated CommandBase with default implementation (null = supports all modes)
- Modified CommandRunner to filter commands based on current compatibility mode
- Added try-catch resilience around command execution
- Marked incompatible commands:
  * EditH1, MdShowH1, MdShowH2 (require well-formed XML)
  * FromPlantumlToPng, FromPlantumlToSvg (not supported on GitHub)
  * FromEmojiToPng (incompatible with GitHub''s native emoji)
  * FromLinkToApplication (desktop-only feature)
  * ManageEmojiAsImages (MdExplorer-specific)
- GitHub-specific commands now only run in GitHub mode:
  * FromEmojiToTextGitHub
  * FromLinkToMarkdownGitHub
  * FromPlantumlToPngGitHub

Fixes XmlException: "The 'img' start tag does not match the end tag of 'mdroot'"
that occurred when GitHub-generated HTML was processed by XML-parsing commands.
EOF
)")
